name: Dollar on Chain
oneLiner: DOC is Money On Chain's overcollateralized USD stablecoin on Rootstock, minted against rBTC vaults with permissionless DOC-for-rBTC redemption.
collateral: rBTC locked in Money On Chain smart contracts on Rootstock
pegMechanism: DOC targets 1 USD through overcollateralized rBTC backing, protocol incentives, and permissionless DOC-to-rBTC redemption through the Money On Chain dApp

mintAuthority.summary: DOC is minted against rBTC locked in Money On Chain's overcollateralized contracts on Rootstock with permissionless DOC-for-rBTC redemption; the MoC token DAO governs the proxy-upgradeable contract suite via the Governor/Changer pattern.

controls.label: Money On Chain MoC contract (rBTC mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the protocol's rBTC overcollateralization; DOC targets 1 USD with permissionless redemption to rBTC.
controls.evidence: DOC is minted against rBTC locked in Money On Chain smart contracts, with permissionless DOC-to-rBTC redemption maintaining the peg.

controls.label: Money On Chain DAO governance (Governor/Changer, proxy-upgradeable)
controls.evidence: The MoC suite is DAO-governed (MOC token) and proxy-upgradeable via the Governor/Changer pattern; upgrades could alter mint/redeem logic, an indirect intervention surface noted in the coin's blacklistability review.

review.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: DOC token 0xe700691d owner() = MoC main proxy 0x6acb83bb0281fb847b43cf7dd5e2766bfdf49038 (confirmed as a contract). The MoC proxy at 0x6acb83bb uses a custom governor storage slot (0x7050c9e0f4ca769c69bd3a8ef740bc37934f8e2c036e5a723fd8ee048ed3f8c3) which returned MoC Governor 0x36d1dc7b41a18c2455ad7c3844a3c711712f6f14 (confirmed as a contract). The MoC Governor is the MoC Foundation BitVoting contract (custom off-chain signature governance), not a token-DAO. No EIP-1967 proxy admin on DOC token itself (slot = zero). Governance chain confirmed on-chain: DOC token → MoC main proxy → MoC Foundation BitVoting Governor. The Governor controls proxy upgrades via the MoC Changer pattern, an indirect mint surface.

unresolvedQuestions: MoC Governor 0x36d1dc is a Foundation BitVoting contract (custom off-chain proposal mechanism, not token-DAO); the number of Foundation keyholders/threshold cannot be confirmed on-chain from public RPC alone.
